description: Create a text-only implementation plan for refactoring the project settings workflow. Make the scope explicit, tie each implementation task to exact files, make ordering or dependency constraints visible, and include per-task acceptance or success criteria even if the headings use harmless formatting variations. Available commands (from package.json scripts): `bun run build`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint`, `bun run test`.

expected_outcome.description: The plan should surface structural planning quality signals the text runner can observe, without requiring exact marker spellings when the same task-level structure is still visible.
